 Who’s Mandy in GTA 6? Why gamers are obsessed with this NPC
 Mandy appears in a mission early on – and has her sights set on Jason
 Emma Clarke Thursday 19 November 2026 12:58 GMT

 Even though Lucia Caminos is the leading lady in GTA 6 , the name on everyone’s lips right now, as they explore the open world of Vice City, is... Mandy.
 Making an appearance in the Pipework mission early on, Mandy is Brian Heder’s tenant – and she owes rent. Of course, when Jason knocks on her door to demand payment, Mandy makes it very clear she’s into him and tries to lure him with her charm and good looks. She even changes into a bikini at one point in a bid to tempt him to stray (as we women are wont to do). 
 Here’s everything you need to know about the GTA 6 NPC (non-playable character) – including who she is, where to find her in the game, and whether you can “romance” her.
 Read more: Where you can buy limited-edition GTA 6 PS5 controllers 
 open image in gallery Jason goes to Mandy’s place in the Pipework mission to collect rent ( Rockstar Games ) And who the hell is Mandy, actually?
 As mentioned, you’ll meet Mandy in the Pipework mission quite early on. 
 When you’re controlling Jason Duval, the game’s other protagonist, Brian Heder will ask you to travel to Key Lento (Leonida Keys) to collect outstanding rent on his behalf. Only when you get there, Mandy, clad in denim short shorts and a knotted white tee, has other ideas.
 Asking you to check out her pipes (sorry, are we back in the Eighties?!), she proceeds to make several attempts to bed you while you get to work.
 To complete the mission, you’ll need to unblock her sink (literally, not figuratively), which has a mysterious item clogging it.
 She’ll then make a last-ditch attempt to woo you before you can be on your merry way and reunite with your actual girlfriend, Lucia.
 Since the game’s release at midnight, some fans have speculated that Mandy is actually a serial killer – in part thanks to the item found in her sink (spoiler: it’s a severed finger), but also because she has acid lying around in her back garden and what appears to be a freshly-dug grave. It’s very much giving Walter White. 
 Read more: Does GTA 6 have more than one ending? Here’s what to expect 
 open image in gallery Once you’re there, she asks you (as Jason) to fix her sink ( Rockstar Games ) Where is she located in ‘GTA 6’?
 You can find the Pipework mission in the Key Lento area.
 Can you ‘romance’ Mandy?
 Despite the fact that GTA 6 very much encourages players to focus on the romantic connection between Lucia and Jason, that hasn’t stopped some gamers from wondering if you can “romance” Mandy instead (sigh). 
 Thankfully, Rockstar Games has made it impossible for Jason’s head to be turned – however many innuendos are made and how thickly Mandy lays it on. So no, you cannot romance Mandy.
 Where to buy ‘GTA 6’
 ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ PS5 game: £64.99, Johnlewis.com 
 open image in gallery ( Getty ) Jake Brigstock , The Independent ’s gaming correspondent, played GTA 6 on a PlayStation 5 and noted in his review how the DualSense controller elevated his playthrough. 
 “The game has been marketed as ‘plays best on PlayStation’, and I can see why that is, especially through gym gameplay,” he wrote. “It’s primarily through the haptic feedback the DualSense wireless controller gives when compared to an Xbox controller.”
 Buy here ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ - Xbox Series X/S: £64.95, Amazon.co.uk 
 open image in gallery ( Amazon ) You can, of course, play the game on Xbox Series. If you’re hoping for a PC or Nintendo Switch 2 version , you may have to wait until late next year.
